convention: T_A_B maps B coordinates into A; L=physical raw LiDAR origin, B=nominal driver target/body frame, F=nominal leveled footprint
physical_interpretation_limit: Measurement is approximate mounting-bottom height; footprint plane physical validity and body origin must be independently verified. Excess alone does not prove that .400 includes all or part of .34751. The implied Z is diagnostic, not deployable calibration.
frame_semantics_issue: Driver applies E numerically before publishing points under rslidar; saved TF base_link<-rslidar is identity. F is applied numerically in NDT, while published TF is named map->base_link and its Z is set to zero. Thus the TF tree alone cannot recover the physical raw LiDAR origin.
measurement_reference_confirmed_by_user: Mid-360 sensor housing bottom plane to floor, approximately 0.46 m
additional_measurement_requested: D435i depth lens optical center vertical height above floor in the same stance; intended to cross-check the nominal body/foot origin independently
